---
title: "All pages"
listing:
  contents: "*.qmd"
  type: grid
  sort: "title"
  categories: cloud
  fields: [image, title, description, categories]
  image-placeholder: images/thumbnail.svg
  image-height: "140px"
mathviz-page:
  category-cloud: true
---

<!--
Shows: a grid listing of every page here, in the theme's card style, with
its category cloud moved above the cards ("All" first). The cloud is on for
this page only, through mathviz-page: (never mathviz: in a page's front
matter -- it would replace every option in _quarto.yml). Each card reads
its page's title, description and categories; a page with an `image:` gets
that picture instead of the placeholder.

  listing cards:  https://apurvanakade.github.io/mathviz/docs/site.html#cards
  category cloud: https://apurvanakade.github.io/mathviz/docs/site.html#category-cloud
-->

<!-- The cloud is unstyled until the site styles it: this is the snippet
     the category-cloud docs give. -->
<style>
.vm-category-cloud .quarto-listing-category { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.3rem 0.6rem; margin-bottom: 1.25rem; }
.vm-category-cloud .category { cursor: pointer; color: var(--vm-text-soft); }
.vm-category-cloud .category.active { color: var(--vm-accent); font-weight: 500; }
</style>

Every page in the starter. Pick a category to narrow the list.
